prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Home wait-time info (4 wins across 7 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 3 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests) proved helpful, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Changes to choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in copy (2 tests), and sign-in hints (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout modifications (4 tests) and sign-in notifications (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or degraded performance.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_desktop_summon_flow: Add an interactive desktop summoning guidance sequence on the home_intro screen showing users how to bring up, hide, and interact with their pet. (why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, summon, or hide their pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [home, redesign] waiting_screen_pet_care_checklist_redesign: Redesign the waiting screen layout into a pet care checklist view showing setup progress and system preparation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s); past waiting screen structural updates proved effective at reducing drop-off.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] new_screen_pet_naming_ceremony: Insert a new pet naming ceremony screen right after picking a friend to build personal attachment before customization. (why: Creating an early emotional bond during adoption improves completion rate and reduces early user abandonment.)
3: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_interaction_stage_redesign: Redesign home_intro layout to a stage layout showcasing pet desktop controls and interactive shortcuts. (why: Support complaints indicate confusion post-setup regarding pet controls and visibility.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] upload_photos_processing_time_info: Display an explicit estimated rendering time and status hint during photo uploading and pet generation. (why: Support received tickets regarding custom pet creation failing or stalling during asset generation.)
5: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_launch_readiness_notification: Add an active desktop readiness notification banner to notify users when pet rendering finishes. (why: The high mean time on waiting screen (2336s) indicates users tab away or minimize while waiting for rendering.)
6: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_story_scroll_redesign: Redesign pick_friend layout to a story scroll presentation highlighting companion personalities. (why: Adoption stage layout redesigns have shown strong historical gains in onboarding conversion.)
7: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_pet_account_hint: Add a prominent contextual hint to sign_in reminding returning users to log into their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: Support's top email theme (8 tickets) involves pets missing or reset after signing in with a wrong/new account.)
8: [finish, notification] home_intro_tray_icon_notification: Display a notification banner on home_intro informing users that the pet app stays accessible from the system tray. (why: Support received tickets about pets not appearing on desktop or users thinking the app failed to open after setup.)
9: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_time_expectation_hint: Add a clear completion time hint on choose_path letting users know onboarding takes under two minutes. (why: Choose_path drop-off is 21.2% with a long mean duration (514s), suggesting user hesitation before committing to a path.)
